description: A journey through our most beautiful years has led us to begin a new chapter called "us" today. It would be a joy to share and cherish this moment together.

ourStory.title: FROM THEN UNTIL NOW
ourStory.description: Somehow, at some point, we began appearing in each other's lives.

story1.title: EVERYTHING STARTED FROM…
story1.content: We met in high school in a supplementary math class. At first we went to find x, but when Vinh saw Linh he unexpectedly found the 'answer to his life'.
story1.subContent: From two students who once struggled with equations, we have since faced many of life's tough 'problems' together. After a decade, Vinh offered the final answer with a marriage proposal. Linh said yes, because after all those years we both understood that:
story1.highlight: "Math can be wrong, but choosing each other is surely right."

story2.title: Untold Story
story2.content: Linh's mother once told a story: one afternoon a young man on a shabby Sirius motorcycle kept circling and revving in front of the gate. Suspicious, she turned and asked:
story2.subContent: Hey Linh, who's that on the Sirius — dark-skinned, hair curled like instant noodles, staring at our house like he's collecting a debt?
story2.subContent2: Hearing that, Linh scoffed and proudly declared:
story2.subContent3: Oh, that's Vinh from my school, Mom. He looks so annoying, I wouldn't even take his gold!
story2.subContent4: But Linh didn't know that the 'curly-haired debt collector' was circling with a very clear intention: to win over Mom's beloved daughter.
story2.subContent5: As the elders say: 'You hate what heaven gives you.' In our case, heaven insisted on the full package: 'an annoying face, dark skin, and curly hair'!

card.title: Walking together for a long time may be the most beautiful thing we've done.
card.content: To this day, every chapter is memorable because we always have each other.

Photography.title: Family Gathering
Photography.description: An intimate meal to begin the celebration, marking the formal joining of both families.

Ceremony.title: Wedding Mass
Ceremony.description: In a solemn and sacred setting, the bride and groom perform the marriage rite and exchange vows before God.

Drink & Dinner.title: Wedding Reception
Drink & Dinner.description: A celebratory banquet where the couple welcomes guests and marks the beginning of their married life.

thankYou.title: Bride Procession
thankYou.description: It's time to 'bring the bride home' — the couple and their families carry out the procession, officially joining as one family.

Moments.title: MOMENTS
Moments.description: A collection of precious memories and unforgettable moments from our journey.
